description: Promotion of affordable housing (bezahlbarer Wohnraum) is a central plank of her political programme; she has been president of the cantonal tenants' association.
Climate protection and adapting Bern to a 'heat-resilient city' (hitzevertraegliche Stadt), including measures against climate warming and more urban greenery, are recurring priorities.

Promotion of city-compatible transport (stadtvertraeglicher Verkehr), including cycling and public transport infrastructure, traffic-calming and the cycle-route network, stemming from her time as transport director.
Increasing equal opportunities (Chancengleichheit / Chancengerechtigkeit) and a non-discriminatory, inclusive city.
Commitment to greater sustainability in the city and to high-quality public space and green areas (e.g. redesigned squares such as the Breitenrainplatz).

area: Sound municipal finances and cross-departmental governance
description: Emphasises stable city finances as the basis for future projects and social balance, and more binding cross-departmental cooperation on issues such as a heat-resilient city, business-friendliness and digitalisation.
